facts.identityBasis: Current Jumeirah Asora Bay / Meraas / La Mer catalogue record; primary operator and developer releases explicitly name the same residences and La Mer South. Exact DLD project 3445 / ID 691710228 is the parent hotel-and-residences registration. Parent register and hotel-only facts retain separate scope; no fan-out to the archived record, hotel rooms or Ocean Mansions.
facts.label: Jumeirah announces the Asora Bay development; residences already described as launched.
facts.note: Dated operator announcement, not the first-ever launch or first marketing date. The article describes 29 residences including six ocean villas; later Meraas articles describe 35 properties. Preserve the differing populations without inventing a reconciliation.
